notes:
## Fixed

- Center the active-window underline exactly beneath the application icon. At 1x scaling, rounding its left edge previously shifted the 11-point underline half a pixel to the right.
- Preserve the native Apple control, the 11-by-2-point active underline, the 4-by-2-point inactive indicator, the bottom gap, button shape and animation behavior.

## Verification

The centering tests now require equal horizontal centers instead of allowing a half-pixel offset. A new offscreen AppKit regression compares the actual rendered icon and indicator at effective 1x and 2x backing scales in both appearances. These checks fail on v1.1.1 and pass after the correction. The full test suite and Release build pass.

No new permissions or dependencies are introduced.
